findings.note: When successful publication is followed by `_discard_batch` failure, the Resolver emits `capability-resolver: warning: ...`. This is a reachable Resolver-owned diagnostic line, but `warning` is not one of REQ-002's closed sixteen diagnostic IDs, directly violating AC-014's requirement that every emitted diagnostic use `capability-resolver: <check-id>: <detail>` with `<check-id>` drawn only from that enum. The captured tests only validate IDs emitted by their registered Block fixtures and do not exercise this cleanup-failure line.
